# Pull Request / Pull Request 描述

## Work item and traceability / 工作项与可追溯性
- Work Item ID:
- Owning Issue URL:
- Related PR(s):
- Session ID / Prompt ID + version + SHA-256:
- Accountable Owner:
- Implementing session:
- Independent Reviewer:
- Integration / Acceptance authority:

## Change / 变更
- Objective:
- Scope and non-goals:
- Changed paths:
- Base branch + SHA:
- Head branch + SHA:

## Decisions / 决策
- [ ] PROPOSED
- [ ] ACCEPTED (include authority and decision record)
- [ ] REJECTED
- [ ] UNRESOLVED
- Decision records and exact source pins:

## Verification / 验证
- Commands and environment:
- Exact tested SHA:
- Results and CI run links:
- Checks NOT RUN and reasons:
- Security / compatibility / migration impact:

## Review and integration / 审查与集成
- Independent review report:
- Same-author or delegated role review disclosure:
- Affected Owner decisions:
- Findings and disposition:
- Dependencies and blockers:

## Bilingual documentation / 双语文档
- Chinese paths:
- English paths:
- Parity evidence:
- GOV-DOC-001 gate result:

## Closeout / 结项
- [ ] Work Item index updated at `14-ai-development/work-items/INDEX.md`
- [ ] Related Issue/PR links updated bidirectionally where practical
- Merge status (do not claim before merge):
- Target branch:
- Merge commit SHA:
- Post-merge verification:
- Remaining work / follow-up Owner / due condition:

Do not mark a check PASS unless it ran on the stated SHA. A PR merge, delegated simulation or AI-authored conclusion does not constitute another Owner's approval.
